title: Cielito Lindo - Songbag canto
edition: Carl Sandburg, The American Songbag, Harcourt, Brace, New York, 1927. Tune supplied by Luis Morones, harmonization by Alfred G. Wathall.
source_location: Printed pp. 298-299, PDF pages 326-327 (one-based), top staff of each system
scope: One written verse and chorus, with no lyrics, piano or additional stanzas. Editorial tempo and fixed MIDI velocity. Source is the Morones/Wathall print.

verification.method: All five vocal systems compared visually with the retained PDF, including pitch, duration, ties, pickup and final partial bar.
verification.playability: Rehearsal melody only; not registered as a machine backing.
